desc: positive: Test TBF with SKBPRIO - catch qlen corner cases
pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
ip link set dev dummy1 up || true
ip addr add 10.10.10.10/24 dev dummy1 || true
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 handle 1: root tbf rate 100bit burst 2000 limit 1000
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 parent 1: handle 10: skbprio limit 1

readback.cmd: tc -s qdisc show dev dummy1 | grep -A 5 'qdisc skbprio'
readback.name: verify
